description: A tool returns a guessable, structured state handle and a later call presents another user's handle. NOTE: the spec's Stateful Tools section is explicitly NON-NORMATIVE, so this fixture measures guidance conformance and is deliberately lower severity.

expected.signal: sequential, structured state handle accepted from a principal that did not create it; handle treated as a capability rather than a name
expected.rationale: server/tools §Stateful Tools (non-normative): a handle is a name, not a capability; servers should validate authorization against the handle on every call, keep handles opaque, and bound their lifetime.

provenance: synthetic — guidance-level only. Split out from requestState during spec verification because the two were being conflated; see docs/SPEC-VERIFICATION-2026-07-28.md, Correction 1.
